description.p: Nibform is a 3D CAD modeler for Linux tablets and convertibles, made to be used with a pen. Sketch with constraints and dimensions, pull faces into solids, round and chamfer edges, and change any step later from the history.

Nibform to modeler 3D CAD dla tabletów i laptopów 2 w 1 z Linuksem, stworzony do pracy rysikiem. Szkicuj z więzami i wymiarami, wyciągaj ściany w bryły, zaokrąglaj i fazuj krawędzie, a każdy krok zmieniaj później z historii.

ul.li: Sketches with constraints and live dimensions
Extrude, fillet, chamfer, shell and boolean operations
Pen, touch and palm rejection; a tablet mode with large controls

description.p: Autosave and crash recovery, recent files, an About dialog, desktop integration and packages.
